project_info.theme: Black Friday YSL makeup bundle for a modern elegant look
project_info.color_palette: Black, gold, cream, red, rose-pink, warm brown

main_subject.detail: A luxury bundle poster with black background and gold podium blocks. Top text includes 'BLACK FRIDAY' and 'ĐỊNH HÌNH CÁ TÍNH RIÊNG CHUẨN QUÝ CÔ HIỆN ĐẠI'. The product lineup includes two YSL lipsticks, a boxed lipstick, a gold cushion compact, and a tall YSL eyeshadow palette opened to reveal multiple neutral and pink shades. Footer text says '*Ưu đãi độc quyền tại website chính hãng YSL Beauty'.
main_subject.style: High-end festive retail bundle poster with glam gold packaging and premium cosmetic staging

composition_elements.text: YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTÉ; BLACK FRIDAY; ĐỊNH HÌNH CÁ TÍNH RIÊNG CHUẨN QUÝ CÔ HIỆN ĐẠI; *Ưu đãi độc quyền tại website chính hãng YSL Beauty
items: Top Left: YSL Beauté logo and a gold 'BLACK FRIDAY' label
Top Right: Large multiline gold headline over black negative space
Bottom Left: Two lipsticks and a boxed lipstick displayed on stepped gold blocks
Bottom Right: Open gold eyeshadow palette with multiple pans and a large cream-gold cube in the foreground
Center/Background: Gold cushion compact centered among layered cream and bronze podium blocks on a matte black background

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Golden sheen, glossy packaging highlights, subtle sparkle around products, high-contrast premium finish
